capacity_gross_kwh.notes: KBB (relaying Cadillac): "floor-mounted 111 kilowatt-hour lithium-ion battery"; Wikipedia: "total capacity of 111 kWh".

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: No page states Celestiq usable energy (Wikipedia and KBB give only 111 kWh). Basis: Celestiq gross 111 kWh with the usable/gross ratio of the Lyriq pack (100/102, Wikipedia), both GM Ultium NCMA cells: 111 x 100/102 = 108.8. Weak: different pack size and module count. OWNER QUESTION.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia infobox: 111 kWh NCMA Ultium; closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: No Celestiq page gives the voltage (Wikipedia: "high-voltage Ultium traction battery"). Basis: the GM Ultium lineup is 400 V class except the 20/24-module trucks (InsideEVs: Ultium modules about 288 V nominal). Weak. OWNER QUESTION.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Cadillac DC fast-charging support page (cadillac.com returns 403, read only as a search excerpt by an earlier researcher, not reproduced): routing to a DC fast charger with Google built-in navigation preconditions automatically, plus a manual Fast Charge Prep in the app. Applied to all Ultium Cadillacs, the same as the LYRIQ records. UNVERIFIED on a page for this model.

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia text says "up to 200 kW (DC)" while its infobox lists 190 kW (unresolved; 190 is the figure of the other 102 kWh Ultium Cadillacs). 200 kept as the figure stated in prose. KBB: 78 miles in 10 minutes. OWNER QUESTION.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: No Celestiq page gives an AC rating. Basis: Cadillac states 11.5 kW as the standard onboard charger with 19.2 kW optional on its Ultium models (Vistiq and Optiq pages); the standard 11.5 kW is recorded because no Celestiq option list was found. OWNER QUESTION.
